title: DevShelf Developer Tool
description: Schema for open-source developer tools, CLI utilities, AI engines, and QA frameworks

repo.description: Direct link to the public GitHub / GitLab repository

description.description: Objective 1-2 sentence description explaining what it does

license.description: Open source license (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0, BSD-3-Clause)

featured.description: Whether this tool is highlighted in weekly spotlights

lastCheckedAt.description: ISO timestamp of most recent HTTP endpoint reachability check

lastVerifiedAt.description: ISO timestamp when entry existence was verified by maintainer or automated pipeline

pricingVerifiedAt.description: ISO timestamp when zero-paywall pricing terms and free tier were verified

authRequirements.description: Detailed authentication requirement (e.g. none, free api key, oauth, registration)

freeTierLimits.description: Specific free tier limits or perpetual zero-cost quotas

verifiedZeroPaywall.description: Whether the resource is verified to have an authentic, permanent zero-paywall tier

redirectUrl.description: Tracked redirect target URL if destination moved

installCommand.description: Explicit single install command overriding fallback git clone

installCommands.description: Ordered multi-step install commands to run separately

installNote.description: Short factual note accompanying explicit install commands

installDocsLabel.description: Human-readable anchor label for official installation docs

customFaqs.description: Custom promotional FAQs unlocked on Paid Spotlight and Category Leader tiers

spotlightPromo.description: Promotional spotlight callout unlocked on Paid Spotlight and Category Leader tiers
